title: Round 2: c1c reads ahead on async backends only
subtitle: eval 66a07143 · probe bc73887e · commit b69e47c9 · protocol rev7 (not approved) · tool code unmerged · guest 4 vCPU / 4096 MiB / swap 16 GiB · QEMU TCG · 2026-10-29

verdict.headline: c1c passed correctness and the mechanism probe, but the fast tier finished only disk 2 and zram 1 of 4 pairs. No performance conclusion.

rows: c1c v2-c1c-xs-ra-safe (commit b69e47c9, tree 58d43c94, parent baseline 5e84ca92): xswap fault readahead admitted only for slots whose physical backend is asynchronous (not SWP_SYNCHRONOUS_IO) and SWP_WRITEOK, with a recheck under ci->lock after swap-cache insertion (xswap_ra_folio_keep) that unwinds the speculative folio before any read. Expect swapin-disk swap_ra up (~115k) and disk swapin_seq.mean_ns down; zram-64k back on the baseline path (swap_ra ~0, seq.p99 ~1.0). PRE-REGISTRATION (before first boot): probe key swapin-disk:swapin_vmstat_delta.swap_ra:up. KILL: MEDIAN zram-64k seq.p99 ratio (baseline/candidate) < 0.834 (A/A guard ratio from noise 0.1988; 0.90 is inside the noise envelope and is advisory only). FALSIFIERS: zram swap_ra not ~0; disk swap_ra not ~115k; disk seq.mean median ratio < 2.5; any page_io.c WARN or SIGBUS in guest serial; any correctness failure. Correctness on the disk backend with swap_ra > 0. A1 (TOCTOU) rests on code reading; zswap-mixed async-backend test NOT RUN.
